# Parse date like 'Thursday, May 18, 2023'

# Resolve Denise and Glenn via phone contacts (exact first_name match)
def resolve_contact(first_name):
    page_index=0
    allc=[]
    while True:
        resp = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query=first_name, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
        if not resp:
            break
        allc.extend(resp)
        page_index += 1
    exact=[c for c in allc if c.get('first_name','').lower()==first_name.lower()]
    print(first_name, 'total_results', len(allc), 'exact_first_name', len(exact))
    # If multiple, just print them; but our earlier lookup showed unique.
    print([(c.get('contact_id'), c.get('first_name'), c.get('last_name'), c.get('email')) for c in exact])
    if len(exact)!=1:
        raise ValueError(f'Ambiguous contacts for {first_name}: {len(exact)}')
    return exact[0]

Denise = resolve_contact('Denise')
Glenn = resolve_contact('Glenn')
print('Denise_email', Denise['email'], 'Glenn_email', Glenn['email'])

from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Login to Gmail, File system, and get tokens
pw_map = {p['account_name']: p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}

gmail_token = apis.gmail.login(username='ja-solomon@gmail.com', password=pw_map['gmail'])['access_token']
file_token = apis.file_system.login(username='ja-solomon@gmail.com', password=pw_map['file_system'])['access_token']

# Draft ID from earlier
draft_id = 518
note = "Can you please take care of splitting expenses? PFA for both of our expenses."

# Fetch current draft to preserve original body
current_draft = apis.gmail.show_draft(draft_id=draft_id, access_token=gmail_token)
orig_body = current_draft['body']
recipients = [(r['name'], r['email']) for r in current_draft.get('recipients', [])]
print('draft_id', draft_id)
print('current_recipients', recipients)
print('draft_subject', current_draft.get('subject'))
print('draft_has_attachments', len(current_draft.get('attachments', [])))
print('body_starts_with', orig_body[:80].replace('\n','\\n'))

# Verify forwarded thread context
belongs_to = current_draft.get('belongs_to_email_thread_id')
response_to = current_draft.get('response_to_email_id')
print('belongs_to_email_thread_id', belongs_to, 'response_to_email_id', response_to)

# Determine absolute path for ~/documents/personal/expenses_james.pdf
parent_dir = "~/documents/personal"
listing = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=file_token, directory_path=parent_dir, recursive=False)
# listing may be list of paths
james_abs = None
for pth in listing:
    if pth.endswith('/expenses_james.pdf') or pth.endswith('expenses_james.pdf'):
        james_abs = pth
        break
print('listing', listing)
print('james_abs', james_abs)

# Create updated body with note prefixed
new_body = note + "\n\n" + orig_body

# Update draft body
update_res = apis.gmail.update_draft(draft_id=draft_id, access_token=gmail_token, body=new_body)
